```lean
intro M R
intro comm_monoid
intro comm_ring
intro finite_M
intro has_enough_roots_of_unity
have : Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card Mˣ :=
  by
    let μ := MulChar M R
    let G := Mˣ
    have h1 : μ is a group homomorphism from M to the multiplicative group of R
    have h2 : μ is injective
    have h3 : μ is surjective
    have h4 : μ is a group isomorphism
    exact h4
```
